service.description: The registered instance settings (moqui.server.InstanceSetting) with their effective values: each with its key, title, group, type, allowed values or limits, value, source (preference: an instance preference; configuration: the deployment's conf or environment; default), whether it is editable here and by the caller, whether a change of its conf value waits for a restart, the operator's note, and for a preference its revision and who changed it, when and why. A secret is masked: value null, valueSet whether it is set. Narrowed by settingGroup, kind (preference or configuration) and settingKey. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW; with ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW alone, the sign-in settings only (the groups Sign-in and Sign-in policy), which the access administrator reads beside the groups' sign-in rules; with ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW or ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW alone, the protocols' settings only (the groups named "Protocols: ...", impl-admin P12).

The effective value of one registered instance preference, for the code that uses it (the report engine's group recipient ceiling, the new-device sign-in window): the stored preference, else the conf property its registration names, else its registered default; numberValue for a whole number. An error for a key that is not a registered preference. A preference is nonsecret by registration, so no permission is needed.

The value of one registered instance preference, as its registration types and limits it, at the revision read (expectedRevision as get#EffectiveSettings gives it, empty when none is set); an empty value removes the preference, so the conf property or the default applies again. Refused, with the reason, for a key that is not a registered preference (NOT_REGISTERED), a value outside its type, allowed values or limits (VALUE_INVALID) and a stale revision (STALE_REVISION). Who, when and why are kept on the row and each value in the audit log. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE and the setting's own manage permission, if it names one.

The sign-in policy the server runs with (impl-admin P10, F110): a fixed list of nonsecret conf attributes no property holds, each by its key (user-facade/password/@min-length and the other password minimums, history and change rules; user-facade/login-key/@expire-hours and device-expire-hours; user-facade/login/@max-failures, disable-minutes and history-store; webapp/session-config/@timeout) with the conf's value, else the one the code falls back to. get#EffectiveSettings shows them through the settings that name one as confAttribute. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW or ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW.

The message translations (moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage), by locale and text (original or translation, ignoring case), a page at a time, each with its revision; with missing and a locale, the originals translated in another locale and not in this one (truncated when more were found than are read). Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

The translation of a message in a locale, at the revision read (empty for a new one); empty removes it. Refused, with the reason, when the translation does not keep exactly the original's ${} placeholders (PLACEHOLDER_MISMATCH), for an original that is a link, a path or a link type or whose ${} values are more than names and simple calls (PLACEHOLDER_UNSUPPORTED: Tools', an instance administrator's), for a locale that is not one (LOCALE_INVALID) and for a stale revision (STALE_REVISION); markup and a link are not accepted. The audit log keeps the text before and after. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

The label translations (moqui.basic.LocalizedEntityField) of the registered label targets (moqui.basic.LocalizedLabelTarget, targetList), by target (targetKey, the entity and field), locale and text, a page at a time, each with the label it translates and its revision; with missing, a target and a locale, that target's labels with no translation in the locale. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

The translation of one label (pkValue) of a registered label target in a locale (or default, the fallback of every locale), at the revision read; empty removes it. Refused, with the reason, for an entity field that is not a registered label target (NOT_REGISTERED), a label that does not exist (LABEL_UNAVAILABLE), a translation that does not keep the label's ${} placeholders (PLACEHOLDER_MISMATCH; PLACEHOLDER_UNSUPPORTED as store#LocalizedMessage), a locale that is not one (LOCALE_INVALID) and a stale revision (STALE_REVISION). The audit log keeps the text before and after. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

The sign-in providers: each with its name, type, whether it is enabled, its readiness (enabled, untested, tested, needsTest, incomplete, unavailable for SAML, inbound) and the callback URL to register at the provider; narrowed by text, type and state (enabled or disabled). With authFlowId, that provider alone (provider): its configuration with each secret as whether it is set, never its value, its identity mappings (an expression or a mapping service marked advanced, never shown), its role mappings each with whether a sign-in may give the group and why not, its link rule and default group, its revision, and the options its forms offer (the groups only for a caller who may map them). Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW or ADMIN_ACCESS_VIEW.

A new sign-in provider (no authFlowId, or a new one; OpenID Connect or OAuth; saved disabled), or changes of one at the revision read (expectedRevision as find#IdentityProviders gives it); only what is given changes. The configuration (name, icon, order, the type's fields, a secret, the identity mappings: a claim name onto the full name, email address, locale or time zone, never an expression) needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE; the role mappings, the default group, the link rule and enabling need ADMIN_ACCESS_MANAGE. Refused, with the reason and nothing written: a stale revision (STALE_REVISION); a mapped or default group the actor may not assign, a privileged group or one granting a sealed permission (UNREGISTERED_BUNDLE, NOT_DELEGABLE, PRIVILEGED_GROUP, SEALED_PERMISSION; roleMapList names each); enabling without a passing test of the configuration as it is now (TEST_REQUIRED), or while a linked account holds access beyond the actor's (HELD_BEYOND); disabling the provider the last administrator signs in by (ADMINISTRATION_PATH); an inbound flow (UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER); SAML enabled, or another type started (UNSUPPORTED_TYPE); identity mappings an instance administrator wrote as expressions (ADVANCED_MAPPING). A change of the client type, client id, issuer, discovery or metadata URL, realm, an endpoint or the Apple team or key needs the secret entered again in the same save, else the stored one is cleared (secretCleared); either way the provider is saved disabled and its test mark cleared (design-admin §8.1), with the reason saying so, as a change of the token signature or the nonce does with the secret kept. URLs are https (http only for the server's own machine on an instance that is not production). The audit log keeps before and after, a secret as replaced or cleared, never its value.

parameter.name: authFlowTypeEnumId
parameter.description: For a new provider: AftOidc or AftOauth

parameter.name: secret
parameter.description: Write-only: the client secret (Apple: the private key), replaced when given

parameter.name: fieldMapList
parameter.description: When given, every identity mapping: each {srcFieldName, dstFieldName}

parameter.name: roleMapList
parameter.description: When given, every role mapping: each {roleName, userGroupId}

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: true to enable, false to disable

service.description: The explicit check of a provider as it is configured now, enabled or not (checkList, each ok or failed with its text): the configuration is complete, every mapped and default group may still be given by a sign-in, and a sign-in could start (org.moqui.sso.AuthServices.check#Flow: an OpenID provider's discovery document is read and the client built as a sign-in builds it). No account is made, nobody is signed in and no token is asked for; a failure's text names URLs and never a secret or a token. A pass is marked on the provider for the configuration it ran against, which enabling requires; a failure clears the mark and leaves the provider as it was. With testRoles, the roles of a test identity, grantPreview says which group each would give. callbackUrl is the redirect URI to register at the provider. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE or ADMIN_ACCESS_MANAGE.

parameter.name: testRoles
parameter.description: Comma or space separated, or a List

service.description: The connections of the registered kinds: each with its kind (adapterKey, adapterTitle), key, name, provider, endpoint summary (a host, never a path or a credential), whether it is enabled, its state (ready, untested, needsTest: disabled until a test passes, disabled, incomplete, readOnly) and its last test; narrowed by kind, group (integration: the Connections list; mail: the mail relays), text, state (enabled, disabled, attention) and, for kinds permitted per organization, the organization; a page at a time. adapterList is the kinds, each with whether one is started here. An EmailServer a mail account owns is never listed. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.

One connection (connection; null when it is not available, as an EmailServer a mail account owns never is): what find#Connections lists, its fields (fieldList: each a name, label, kind, value, options, whether it is an endpoint field, help), its secrets as whether each is set, never a value (secretList), what it lacks (problem), why it is not changed here (readOnlyReason), its test mark and the checks of its last test (checkList: a host, a status, a kind of failure; never a response body), whether the server may reach it on the private network, what its kind adds (a payment gateway's organizations) and its revision. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.

A new connection of a kind that is started here (no connectionKey; values.connectionId its id where the kind takes one; saved disabled), or changes of one at the revision read (expectedRevision as get#Connection gives it): values holds the kind's fields and secrets by name, and only those given change, each validated by its kind; a name the kind does not declare is ignored, and an executable name is never one. Refused, with the reason and nothing written: a stale revision (STALE_REVISION); an EmailServer a mail account owns (ACCOUNT_OWNED); a connection of a transport or sign-in that is not changed here (READ_ONLY); a kind that is not started here (NOT_CREATABLE) or an id in use (KEY_IN_USE); enabling one that lacks something (INCOMPLETE) or has no passing test of its configuration as it is (TEST_REQUIRED); the kind's own refusals (a relay that signs in without TLS: INSECURE_TRANSPORT; a gateway's validation). A change of an endpoint field (a host, port, URL, user or kind of sign-in) needs the secrets entered again in the same save, else the stored ones are cleared (secretCleared); either way the connection is saved disabled and its test mark cleared, and a passing test#Connection enables it (design-admin §8.1). On a production instance a connection started or repointed here reaches no loopback, private or link-local address (the record's allowPrivateNetwork N, which its sender enforces and this service never sets back). The audit log keeps before and after, a secret as replaced or cleared, never its value. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE.

parameter.name: values
parameter.description: The kind's fields and write-only secrets by name; each is validated by its kind

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: true to enable, false to disable

service.description: The explicit test of a connection as it is configured now, enabled or not (checkList, each ok or failed with its text): its configuration is complete, then the kind's own check: a remote's address answers one request with no credentials and no body (HEAD, ten seconds, the status only); a relay connects and signs in (org.moqui.mail.EmailServices.test#EmailServer), and with testKind send one fixed message goes to the caller's own address; a printer takes a fixed test page (org.moqui.impl.PrintServices.print#Document); a mail sign-in provider is checked for its client without a request. Nothing is sent while the configuration is incomplete or a secret an endpoint change cleared has not been entered again, and nothing to a loopback, private or link-local address for a connection that may not use the private network. A text names a host, a status code or a kind of failure, never a secret, a response body or the remote's own words. A pass is marked for the configuration it ran against and enables a connection that waited for it (enabledByTest); a failure clears the mark and leaves the connection as it was. An EmailServer a mail account owns is refused (ACCOUNT_OWNED). Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE.

parameter.name: testKind
parameter.description: send: a relay's named test message after its connection test

service.description: Where a connection is used (consumerList: each an ownerName, recordType, recordId, recordName, use and state): the kind's own answer (the messages of a remote, the templates of a relay, a printer's jobs), then that of each registered provider (moqui.server.ConnectionConsumerProvider: the owner of records that name it), which answers only what the caller may see there. Counts and names, never a message, an address or a credential. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.

What a component's connection adapter implements (moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.adapterServiceName): one operation of its kind, list, get, store, test or consumers, answered as result with what the operation of the framework's own kinds answers (connectionList; connection; store#Connection's and test#Connection's out-parameters; consumerList). It is called by the services above only, checks ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW or ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE itself with its own domain rules, and is built with the engine of ConfigurationConnections.js (lib.engine), so the endpoint-change rule, the write-only secrets and the test mark are the same for every kind. No group is authorized to call it directly.

What a connection consumer provider implements (moqui.server.ConnectionConsumerProvider.serviceName): the records of its owner that use the connection, as find#ConnectionConsumers lists them, only those the caller may see there. A consumer with ownsConnection true is a record of another kind whose connection this is (a gateway's remote): the connection is then read only as its own kind and changed through that record's kind, whose rules hold on every path; that answer is not narrowed by what the caller may see.

The protocols of the server (protocolList), each with its state told apart: absent (this build leaves it out, or no build has it), disabled (built, and the conf does not turn it on), failing (turned on and it did not start, with the reason the server recorded, or its last check did not pass), untrusted (running while what it trusts does not hold), notStarted (turned on, in a process that opened no listeners) and ready. Each also: built and the build feature, enabled, the reason, where its listener is bound, where the answer comes from (Build, Startup or Configuration), the settings group get#EffectiveSettings shows its configuration under, the owner its links open (ownerKey) and its checks with their last results (checkList, also flat as checkList of the answer). SMTP reception answers its trust: trusted only while it listens, smtp_allowed_addresses names addresses that are no range of every address and can reach the address it is bound to, and smtp_authserv_id is set; a mismatch is never ready (untrusted, trustProblems in words), and a listener that takes mail from the internet trusts no gateway (direct). Narrowed to one protocolKey. No secret, key or key file is read. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW, ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW or ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW.

Run one check of a protocol (checkKey, one of its checkList) and keep its result as the check's last: configuration (the readiness read again; nothing is sent), listener (one TCP connection from this server to the address the conf binds, closed at once) or publicAddress (the name the deployment gives its clients is looked up and its port connected to from this server, closed at once). A check that leaves the server runs only with confirmed true (CONFIRM_REQUIRED otherwise, and nothing is sent); a protocol that is not built (NOT_BUILT) or is off (NOT_ENABLED) is sent nothing. The target is the conf's own, from the server's fixed list: none is taken from the request. The result names a host, a port and a kind of failure, never the other side's words. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE.

What the server knows of its protocols, which a script cannot read: the build (packageName, featureList), the entries of the startup report for a fixed list of listeners and integrations (entryList: section, name, state on, off, failed, skipped or notBuilt, detail), whether this process opened its listeners (serverStarted) and a fixed list of nonsecret conf attributes of smtp-server, ssh-server and git-server by element/@attribute (confMap). get#ProtocolReadiness reads it. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW, ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW or ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW.

One TCP connection, closed as soon as it is made, to a target of the server's fixed list by its key (smtp.listener, ssh.listener, xmpp.listener, sip.listener, turn.listener: the address the conf binds; web.public, ssh.public, turn.public, xmpp.public: the public name and port the conf gives clients), whose host and port are the conf's own properties: target, external, reached, failureKind (notConfigured, notFound, refused, timedOut, unreachable), internalAddress and millis. A public target is tried only with confirmed true. test#Protocol calls it. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE.

The instance's message types (moqui.service.message.SystemMessageType), by name, a page at a time (typeList, typeCount): id, name, content type, direction (out, in, both or none, from what it is routed by), its send, consume and receive handlers (a registered handler by its title, another by its service name), its owner, what recovery is registered for its messages, its file transport options, whether it is changed here (configurable: its owner registered a handler for delegated administration; canChange with ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE too) and its revision. Narrowed by a term (id or name) and direction. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.

One message type's contract and use: its row as find#MessageTypes answers it (messageType); its handlers by role (handlerList: send and consume with the current service, whether it may be chosen here and the handlers its owner registered for it, each by key, title and owner; receive, never chosen here); the service that documents its producer; the remotes of this type (remoteList, each with whether it is disabled); what its owner registered for the recovery of its messages (recoveryList: owner, each action's mode in words, the owner's permission, the permission that reads a payload, what makes a repeat safe); and its messages of the last countDays days by status (countList). Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.

Change a message type its owner registered for delegated administration, at the revision read: its name, content type and file transport options (sendPath, which may hold only the names the sender gives; receivePath, receiveFilePattern, receiveMovePath and receiveResponseEnumId, which hold no ${}), and its send or consume service, set only to a handler registered for this type and role (moqui.server.MessageHandler), by the registration's key. A parameter not given is left as it is; an empty text clears an optional one; a handler is never cleared; the service that receives the type's messages is never chosen here; no service name is taken from the request. Refused, with the reason: a type with no registered handler (NOT_CONFIGURABLE), a key that is not a handler of this type and role (HANDLER_NOT_REGISTERED), a stale revision (STALE_REVISION). Each changed field leaves an audit row with the reason. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE.
